_comment: Subsistema G smoke — Google Docs. The agent creates a doc from markdown, reads the outline, replaces a token, adds a tab, exports as PDF, and reports the resulting URL. Requires GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS + COLMENA_GDOCS_DEFAULT_PARENT_FOLDER_ID env vars and a Drive folder shared (Edit) with the SA. Run: `set -a; source .env; set +a; cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/agents/gdocs_smoke.json --agent-session-id g_smoke_$(date +%s) --include-extra-info`

test_payload.prompt:
Run a Google Docs smoke. Use ONLY these exact tool names (all start with the gdocs_ prefix):

1. Call gdocs_create_from_markdown({title: 'Colmena G Smoke <UTC timestamp>', markdown: '# Reporte\n\nEste es el __PLACEHOLDER__ original.\n\n## Detalles\n\nMás contexto aquí.\n'}). Capture meta.doc_id and meta.url from the response.
2. Call gdocs_read_outline({doc_id}). Confirm there is at least one heading_1 entry titled 'Reporte'.
3. Call gdocs_replace_text({doc_id, find: '__PLACEHOLDER__', replace: 'contenido final'}). Confirm at least one change in the response.
4. Call gdocs_add_tab({doc_id, title: 'Anexo'}).
5. Call gdocs_list_tabs({doc_id}). Confirm the 'Anexo' tab is present.
6. Call gdocs_export({doc_id, format: 'pdf'}). The response is an attachment reference — note its document_id.
7. Final report (under 200 words): the doc url, the replace_text change count, the tab titles you observed, and the exported PDF attachment id.

config.system_message: You are an assistant exercising the Google Docs tool surface. Use ONLY the exact tool names provided in your tool schemas (they all start with gdocs_). Do NOT invent tool names or drop the prefix. Report what you observed at each step (heading count, change count, tab list, attachment id).
